description: ICS / iCalendar parser: parse ICS text or a public .ics calendar URL. Returns VEVENTs with summary, start/end normalized to UTC/ISO (or marked floating), timezone, location, and RRULE recurring events expanded to at most 50 occurrences in a bounded window. Data is not stored. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).
name: ics_parse
